history.narrative: A small, fabulously rich federation that punches far above its weight through money, ports, proxies and a modern military. Led by Mohamed bin Zayed, it combines a hard anti-Islamist line with commercial hedging between Washington, Beijing and Moscow, and has learned in 2026 that it sits on Iran's front line.
